sidebar.mottoSub: Training writes to copies; publishing needs root

err.noSkillMd: The selected folder has no SKILL.md
err.multiple: Upload one skill at a time (several SKILL.md files selected)
err.badName: Invalid skill folder name: {{name}} — only letters, digits and . _ - are allowed, and SKILL.md must be at the folder root

upload.nested: SKILL.md is not at the root of the selected folder "{{picked}}" but in the sub-folder "{{nested}}" — it will be uploaded under the sub-folder name "{{name}}"; pick that sub-folder directly to use another name.
upload.tasksPartial: {{file}} in the package: {{ok}} rows passed, {{bad}} failed{{added}}
upload.tasksError: {{file}} in the package was not imported: {{msg}}
upload.title: Upload a skill
upload.subtitle: Pick a skill folder (SKILL.md at its root). The copy is managed by you and root; training runs on the copy and never touches the skill library.
upload.pick: Click to choose a skill folder
upload.limits: ≤ 500 files · ≤ 30 MiB total · ≤ 5 MiB per file · .git / node_modules / .evo are skipped
upload.docOnly: Documentation-only skill: only the slow loop (agent runner) applies; of the six gates only G0 / G3 are meaningful.
upload.withTests: Has unit tests: G4 can run, and the fast loop uses them as the regression check.
upload.noTestsHint: No tests/unit/: the fast loop can only rely on G0–G3 and repro tests written during training. Consider adding tests before uploading.

diff.baseTraining: Compared: copy when training started → this staging
diff.baseBackup: Compared: copy before adoption → this staging
diff.none: This staging matches the working copy — nothing to show.
diff.noneSince: This staging changes no files (training found nothing better and kept the original).

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.subtitle: Patterns and logs distilled by training, per skill; read-only — writing is the trainer's job.
wiki.empty: Nothing distilled for this skill yet — pattern cards and logs appear after the first training run.

nightly.title: Nightly
nightly.maxCostHint: Empty = the .env per-run cap ${{env}}; up to ${{max}} (not above the per-night total)
nightly.mock: mock backends (free, for trying the flow)
nightly.hint: Runs inside the window only when enough new checkable tasks arrived since the last nightly run; all nightly runs are serial, with a per-night total cap of ${{cap}}; produces a staging only — adopting and publishing stay manual; paused automatically after {{n}} nights without gain.
nightly.summary: Last night ({{d}}) nightly training handled {{n}} skill(s)
nightly.summaryNone: Nightly training has not run yet

r.deferred: Night budget used up, moved to next night

card.reimportDone: Copy refreshed from the skill library
card.gateSkippedHint: A skipped gate checked nothing — see the reason in its cell
card.feedbackNoneUpload: none yet (uploaded skills get no chat feedback; use task sets)
card.feedbackLine: shown {{shown}} · answered {{answered}} · 👍 {{votes}} · good {{good}} okay {{neutral}} poor {{bad}} · from {{projects}} projects, {{users}} people
card.divergent: {{p}} diverges here — consider deriving a copy for it
card.contractEmpty: No entrypoints in the contract yet
card.fixThenRecheck: fix, then re-check; non-root cannot start training while G1 fails
card.recheckNoPerm: The check runs the copy's tests: only the uploader or root can run it
card.removeConfirm: Remove the copy? Training outputs are archived with it

ev.testsPhase: Tests grow first this round (code frozen)
ev.releaseDone: Release evaluation done (this staging's test split is now used up)
ev.resumedSub: The first {{r}} round(s) finished last time (cost ${{c}}); S₀ is not re-measured; the interrupted round is redone
ev.budgetReachedSub: Spent ${{s}} / cap ${{m}}; verification already due still runs, the run stops at the end of this round

chart.empty: No curve until the first round finishes — val pass rate will be drawn here (y axis fixed 0–100%)
chart.title: val pass rate

detail.checkpoint: This run stopped after {{r}} completed round(s) and saved a checkpoint — resuming continues at round {{next}} without re-measuring the baseline or re-running finished rounds.
detail.queuedHint: Queued — events appear here once it starts
detail.diffLater: Per-file staging diff appears here once training finishes

runs.title: Training
runs.subtitle: One training job at a time, the rest queue; outputs go to staging only — publishing is a separate action.
runs.empty: No training jobs yet. Start one above — for the first run, try mock or rounds=1 to see the flow.

proc.rolloutMeasure: {{r}}Running train tasks to see what the current version fails
proc.rolloutAfterFix: {{r}}Re-running train tasks with the adopted fix
proc.rolloutG7: {{r}}G7 holdout gate: scoring the changed version on val
proc.attribution: {{r}}Attribution: code defect, doc defect or capability gap?
proc.counterfactual: {{r}}Counterfactual: dropping doc sections one by one to find harmful ones
proc.fastLoop: {{r}}Fast loop: model proposes code fixes, each goes through G0–G6
proc.governance: {{r}}G8 governance: ledger, bloat and leak checks
proc.slowUpdate: {{r}}Between-round review: diff against the last version, write lessons
proc.retire: {{r}}Retiring guidance that is no longer needed
proc.staging: Writing the best version into staging
proc.proposing: Asking the model for fixes: {{d}} defects, {{k}} each
proc.proposingDoc: Asking the model for doc edits: {{d}} doc defects

harvest.recovered: Recovered the tasks mined last time that were never imported ({{id}})
harvest.title: Mine from sessions
harvest.hint: Reads only sessions you can see that used this skill (or carry a vote for it); preview the sessions first (free), then mine (calls a model); review what was mined before importing.
harvest.mockHint: Offline miner: zero cost, flow only
harvest.noProjects: No Claude sessions you can see.
harvest.empty: Pick a skill and projects, then "Preview sessions".
harvest.noneForSkill: No session in the selected projects / window used this skill (or has a vote for it) — nothing to mine.
harvest.sessionsFound: Will read {{n}} session(s) that used this skill ({{v}} with user votes)
harvest.skippedOther: {{m}} more session(s) never used this skill and have no vote for it — not mined
harvest.noTasks: No checkable tasks (anything without criteria is dropped, never invented).

err.looksJsonl: — this looks like JSONL (one object per line); switch the format to jsonl to see per-line results
err.topLevel: The top level must be a JSON array (or {"tasks": [...]})
err.rowNotObject: Every row must be an object
err.noReference: Missing expected_output (0 / false / null are valid values) or a rubric (≥ 8 characters)
err.badSplit: split must be train / val / test (got {{got}})
err.badChecks: checks must be an array of objects
err.bothRefs: Both expected_output and rubric given; expected_output wins

tasks.title: Task sets
tasks.subtitle: Attached per skill; paste or pick JSON / JSONL / CSV. The browser validates first, the server validates again, then the tasks are stored.
tasks.deriveHint: Turn tests/unit cases into rule tasks (same permission as adding)
tasks.dropHint: ≤ 5 MiB per file · ≤ 5,000 rows · input and expected_output (or rubric) required (0 / false / null are valid values)
tasks.summaryEmpty: Paste or pick a file; results appear here row by row
tasks.uploaderOnly: Only the uploader or root can store tasks
tasks.rootOnly: Only root can store tasks for a library skill
tasks.storedEmpty: No task sets yet. Import the first batch on the left.
tasks.feedbackRootOnly: "From feedback · pending" (turning 👎 and survey expectations into tasks) is handled by root.
tasks.inboxHint: 👎 / survey feedback that carries a note or an expected result. Expected result → exact task; note only → rubric task. Good / neutral / bad → outcome success / mixed / fail.
tasks.inboxEmpty: Nothing pending. 👎 / survey answers with a note or an expected result show up here.

assets.title: Skill assets
assets.subtitle: Managed copies come from the skill library or your own upload; training runs only on copies, and live is replaced only on “publish”.
assets.empty: No managed copies yet. root can import from the skill library; anyone can upload their own skill.
assets.liveOnly: In the skill library, not yet imported
assets.feedbackOnly: Feedback exists in chat, but the skill is in neither the library nor the copies
assets.feedbackOnlyHint: Probably a project-level skill or a typo; feedback attaches once the skill is imported

run.g1MissingTools: G1 could not run: the server is missing {{tools}}; ask an admin to install it and re-run the health check
run.noSkill: Pick a skill you can train
run.notBootstrapped: This copy is not bootstrapped yet (S₀ not frozen)
run.noTasks: This skill has no task set yet
run.g1Fail: G1 security gate is {{v}}; non-root cannot start training — fix it and re-check
run.g1Unknown: Not checked yet; run "Re-check" on the Assets page first
run.overBudget: Remaining daily budget ${{left}} is below this run's cost cap ${{cost}}
run.sameModel: The evaluator must differ from the proposer models (both fast and slow; aliases are compared by the real model they map to)
run.overHardCost: Cost cap ${{v}} is above the hard ceiling ${{cap}}
run.overCostCap: Cost cap ${{v}} is above the per-run cap ${{cap}} set by the admin — lower it, or ask the admin to change PRISM_SKILLWHET_MAX_COST_USD in .env
run.overMinutesCap: Time cap {{v}} min is above the allowed {{cap}} min
run.pytestNoTests: This copy has no tests/unit/ — under the pytest runner no task scores, so training can only end in no_signal. Use agent (or move the tests into tests/unit/)
run.mixedNoTests: This copy has no tests/unit/ — the pytest half of mixed does nothing
run.rootOverCost: Above the .env per-run cap ${{cap}}: root may exceed it — runs with your ${{v}}, recorded in the audit log as cost_override
run.rootOverMinutes: Above the .env time cap {{cap}} min: root may exceed it — runs for {{v}} min
run.fewVal: Only {{n}} val task(s): the score can take just a few values and "improved" means little; aim for at least 5
run.clamped: Some values were above the cap and were lowered: {{list}}
run.title: New training
run.mockHint: Offline mock backend: zero cost, flow only
run.noneAvailable: (no skill you can train — upload one, or ask root)
run.rootNoLimit: root has no daily budget limit
run.capRoot: .env cap {{v}} (used when empty); root may go up to {{hard}}, recorded in the audit log
run.models: Models · eval model must differ from the proposal model
run.advanced: Advanced (k {{k}} per defect · edit budget {{p2}} · refine {{r}}× · workers {{w}} · judge samples {{j}} · stop after {{n}} rounds without acceptance)
run.notice: Training really executes the bundle's code and tests/ on the server (sandbox: rlimits, plus network isolation where unshare is available); results only go to staging and never touch the skill library.
run.modelNotAllowed: You cannot use these models: {{list}} (only models enabled in the model catalog, or on the .env allowlist)

status.claudeBad: no claude CLI · slow loop (agent runner) unavailable

status.banditBad: no bandit · G1 loses a layer

status.title: Health

versions.adoptDone: Adopted {{sid}} into the working copy; publishing still needs a root click
versions.releaseQueued: Release evaluation queued ({{id}}); this staging gets exactly one look at the test split
versions.publishDone: Published {{n}} files to the library{{rb}}; long-lived sessions must be reopened to see the new version
versions.title: Versions
versions.subtitle: Staging is the training output; adopting into the copy is step one, publishing to the library is root's step two; 3 previous versions are kept for rollback.
versions.empty: This skill has no training output yet. Start one under "Training".
versions.liveMissing: This skill is not in the library yet (it will be after publishing).
versions.historyEmpty: Nothing published yet (publishes before hd were not recorded).
versions.pick: Pick a staging on the left to see its changes.
versions.noImprove: no improvement (holdout gate did not accept)
versions.releaseSkipped: Not evaluated — held-out evaluation was skipped at adoption (or this predates ha)
versions.releaseNone: Not evaluated — training never looks at test; run one release evaluation when you intend to adopt / publish this one
versions.contractHint: base = the copy at training time; candidate = this output; protocol = runner + models + gate config
versions.rootOnlyAdopt: Only root can adopt for a library-sourced skill
versions.forceConfirm: The holdout gate did not accept this staging; forcing writes it into the copy anyway.
versions.forceNoRelease: No release evaluation for this staging yet — no independent evidence it is better; adopt anyway?
versions.releaseWorse: No improvement on the held-out set (candidate ≤ baseline); adopt anyway?
versions.needAdopt: The copy must be the result of an adoption before it can be published — adopt a staging first
versions.needLive: This skill is not in the library; use "Publish as new skill"
versions.alreadyLive: A skill with this name is already in the library; use "Publish to library" to replace it
versions.publishConfirm: {{skill}} in the library will be replaced as a whole directory (previous version archived); new sessions in every project see it immediately.
versions.publishNewConfirm: {{skill}} will be created in the library; new sessions in every project can use it immediately.
versions.publishRootOnly: Already in the copy; publishing to the library needs root.

eval.title: Evaluation
eval.subtitle: Six-gate check + validation / holdout pass rates of the latest run (S₀ → best). test is observed only, never selected on.
eval.empty: No managed skill yet. Import or upload one under "Assets" first.
eval.testPending: Not evaluated (release-once: evaluate this staging once on the Versions page)
eval.noRunHint: This skill has not been trained yet; evaluation numbers appear after the first run.

models.searchOrType: Search, or type a gateway model name
models.defaultGatewayOnly: SkillWhet can only use shared models on the default gateway
